adaptive_budget_efficiency.description: Core scaled target: an adaptive stopping policy should save more reasoning tokens than a reference adaptive baseline while satisfying answer-error and premature-defer risk constraints.
adaptive_budget_efficiency.notes: Scaled synthetic benchmark reference. The paper reports the corresponding outcomes primarily as plotted curves over risk levels and task mixes rather than exact scalar table entries, so these values document this gym's reproduced operating point.

accuracy.description: Overall answer accuracy at the selected stopping point.

solvable_accuracy.description: Accuracy restricted to examples that can be solved within the full reasoning budget.

token_fraction.description: Fraction of full-budget reasoning tokens consumed by the stopping policy.

token_savings.description: Reduction in reasoning tokens relative to always using the full budget.

unsolvable_token_savings.description: Token savings restricted to examples not solved within the full reasoning budget.

false_positive_risk.description: Risk of stopping with an emitted answer that is wrong.

false_negative_risk.description: Risk of deferring or abstaining before later trajectory steps would become correct.

max_realized_risk.description: Larger of the realized answer-error and premature-defer risks at the selected operating point.

risk_excess.description: Unscored diagnostic amount by which the larger realized risk exceeds the configured tolerance.

defer_fraction.description: Fraction of examples for which the policy defers or abstains before the full budget.

defer_precision.description: Fraction of defer/abstain decisions that occur on examples unsolved by the full budget.

exit_budget_fraction.description: Fraction of examples that still consume the full reasoning budget.

risk_control.description: Risk-control target: validation-selected operating points should keep realized risks at or below the requested operating risk more reliably than naive validation tuning.
risk_control.notes: Scaled synthetic benchmark reference. The paper reports risk-control behavior as empirical curves; this gym records the reproduced scalar operating point used for scoring.

difficulty_mix_3_1.description: Scaled difficulty-mix setting with a 3:1 solvable:unsolvable mix. Useful policies should add modest token savings while maintaining risk constraints.
difficulty_mix_3_1.notes: Scaled synthetic benchmark reference for the paper's solvable:unsolvable mix axis. The paper presents this axis as a curve, so this entry records the reproduced scalar mix used by the gym.
